reviews.title: Best Yoga App
reviews.text: I learnt yoga via fitify yoga on android and could never purchase the pro version b/c I installed apps via apk (for privacy), this was the first subscription I bought for iphone, and was gutted when I discovered it didn’t include the fitify yoga features. They have updated the app and the yoga no longer has reps and has diverse poses. The other features are decent too, but I swear by fitify for its yoga. The new voice is a bit more abrupt than the android version, but I’m so grateful I can use this app now, I will just get used to the voice. Thank you to the developers! Please add the core body yoga next! 🙏

reviews.title: Love This App
reviews.text:
Fitify is the perfect workout app for my lifestyle. I am able to customize the workouts and am actually doing them because it’s not too much for me to handle and it does not take up a huge amount of my time. I do this at home and on my time and my schedule. 
I am in week 5 and can already see results.! I will be continuing this app once my 12 week starter plan is complete.

reviews.title: Some good and bad
reviews.text: The kettlebell workouts are good enough, however when trying to do the yoga workouts, I think the app falls short because there’s no logic or routine to the opposes they put you through when there should be some kind of series of moves that you work through and build up because you can’t catapult into a very difficult Balance pose right out the front without warming up into it and you can potentially injure yourself if you don’t warm up properly and you try and stretch yourself too far. The AI feature that’s included is effectively less accurate than using a tape measure on yourself and should not be used for any reason.
